question.text: Portfolio return 35%, benchmark return 28%, Rf = 6%, portfolio SD = 42%, benchmark SD = 30%. M² is:

explanation.text: The Logic: M² = [(Benchmark SD / Portfolio SD) × (Rp - Rf)] + Rf = [(30/42) × (35 - 6)] + 6 = [0.714 × 29] + 6 = 20.71 + 6 = 26.71%. The Trap: 35% is raw return; 28% is benchmark; 14% is miscalculation. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B-specific calc. Manager's Pro-Tip: In this example, M² of 26.71% < benchmark 28% = underperformance, despite higher gross return — risk-adjustment matters.
